text:
Emma: Quick sync — we're targeting the 'Throughput & Cost' release next Tue 10:00am PT. Need eng signoff on changelog + final docs links + a short webinar slot. Can eng confirm canary timing and whether the benchmark numbers are final?

Jorge: We can ship Tue. Recommend a 2hr canary starting 8:00am PT. Changelog draft is up: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/throughput-changelog-draft — please review. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Marketing needs the final changelog URL and a 3–5 bullet feature summary by EOD today. Also we need a webinar outline (20–30m) + CTA and lead capture details.

Mark: Docs PR is pending: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/789 — API example needs the new batch param updated before merge.

Sarah: I can take webinar copy and the slides. For the benchmark narrative let's keep it tight: one graph (cost per token), one slide on latency SLO gains, and one short customer-style scenario. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Jorge: Bench numbers are final on our side — rough summary pasted below:

```\nBenchmark summary (8k sequence):\n- Token cost: ~35% reduction vs baseline\n- p50 latency: -18% at 1k concurrency\n- throughput: +2.6x sustained on pool-1\n```

Jorge: I'll attach the raw CSV to the PR after this thread.

deploy-bot: deploy plan locked: canary window 2024-11-12T15:00:00Z -> 2024-11-12T17:00:00Z on pool-1. Alerting hooks enabled.

Priya: For inbound leads we need a UTM'd landing page + a webhook that posts to SFDC. Ops: can you expose a simple POST endpoint for form payloads (email, company, use_case, utm_source)?

Mark: Ops will stand up the webhook by EOD. Priya — send the JSON schema and required field names and I'll wire it to SFDC.

Emma: Final asks from marketing: 1) exact changelog URL to insert in the announcement, 2) docs canonical link for the API example, 3) webinar registration link (or placeholder) so we can schedule the email and social push. Please drop links here once ready. :spiral_calendar:

Jorge: Changelog final URL added to the draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/throughput-changelog-v1.1 — updated changelog section and TL;DR bullets. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Copy approved. I'll post draft social copy + webinar invite and the landing page to this thread in ~45m. :rocket:

Sarah: Slide deck draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood.ai/throughput-deck-v1 — comments welcome, I'll lock slides after merge. :page_with_curl:

Emma: Awesome — thanks everyone. If anything slips, flag here and we'll delay the external posts. tagging Jorge and Mark for final merge + webhook confirmation.

Mark: Will confirm webhook URL once deployed and paste it here.

Jorge: I'll merge the docs PR after the API example update is in place.

Priya: I'll follow up with timings for the staged social cadence and the webinar RSVP flow in a separate thread but will drop the links here when ready.

Emma: Great — locking on Tue 10:00am PT unless we hear blockers by EOD.
